svg.title: Two backdrops, two halves
svg.desc: How the credits fade from one battle backdrop to the next. The background's tile memory and colours are split into two halves, each able to hold one backdrop. First, Vale in the storm shows from half 1 while the next backdrop, Sol Sanctum's stone hall, is loaded into the hidden half 0. Then the screen blends from one to the other over 64 frames. Then Sol Sanctum shows from half 0, and the backdrop after it, the grassland, is loaded into half 1, which is no longer shown. The halves take turns, so a backdrop is never loaded while it is on screen.
svg.text: Vale shows; the next loads unseen
Blend from one to the other
A backdrop is never loaded while it shows.
